title: Implement ADR-0024: lore init detects, offers, and instructs on tracker readiness — it never installs (DEC-57)
description:
Implements ADR-0024 (docs/adr/0024-lore-init-stops-and-instructs-on-tracker-readiness.md), accepted by the operator as DEC-62 option A and landed on dev as opum-ai/lore-cli#436; LCLI-655 is Done. The ADR's "What implementation will touch" section is the scope of record; this task exists so the work is reviewed against that record rather than rediscovered.

Why it matters now: retiring lore's unpinned global install removes the repository's only global-install site from every path a test can reach, which is the cause of the windows-latest red on the held bump draft opum-ai/lore-cli#433 (a required context). Until this lands, #433 cannot go green. Ordering, per opum-agent's execution call: this lands on its own follow-up PR, NOT on #433; #433 is realigned afterwards; then the rc staging and opum-cli-e2e qualification under OPAG-761.

Deliberately deferred, not in scope: the JIRA->Quest offer. DEC-62 option A defers it until quest ships a runnable Jira migration command; the importer exists dormant in quest-cli and released quest 0.11.0 exposes only "migration backlog".

acceptanceCriteria.text: In the TTY wizard, selecting `quest` when the quest CLI is not on PATH offers O1; answering yes prints the pinned remedy (`npm install -g @opum-ai/quest@<lore's exact version>`, then `quest init` unless `.quest/workspace.toml` already exists, then rerun `lore init`) and exits 3 with the directory byte-identical to before the run; answering no returns to the tracker question and detection continues (O1b).
Selecting `quest` when the CLI is on PATH but `.quest/workspace.toml` is absent offers O2; yes stops with `quest init` then rerun, exits 6, writes nothing; no returns to the tracker question (O2b).

A second selection of the same unready backend within one wizard run prints no second offer: it stops with the same instructions as the first offer's yes (O12), within the existing MAX_TRACKER_ATTEMPTS bound.

`--tracker quest` with quest not on PATH stops with the O1 remedy at exit 3 (today: advisory, exit 0), and `--tracker backlog` stops at exit 3 when backlog is missing (N5) and exit 6 when it is present but the project is uninitialized (N6); a bare non-TTY `lore init` with no `--tracker` is unchanged (pins the default backend, probes nothing, exit 0).
`--install-tracker` and `--no-install-tracker` are still accepted and print the deprecation note, and install nothing on any path; the two together remain a usage error (exit 2).

The wizard's in-wizard Backlog migrate/keep/backlog prompt is replaced by the O3/O6 offer (yes stops with the migration commands and writes nothing, exit 6; no proceeds), `runWizardBacklogMigration` and its interactive collision retry are removed, and `runBacklogMigration` still serves the explicit `--migrate-backlog` path.

No code path reachable from the test suite installs a tracker CLI: `src/adapters/tracker-environment.ts` exposes no installer (its install command survives as text only), `src/cli.ts` forwards a `trackerEnvironment` seam and no installer seam, and the LORE-260 test in `test/cli.test.ts` injects a detected environment so no test reads the machine or shells out to npm.
`missingTrackerBinary`'s remedy and the environment summary's install line name lore's own exact quest version, never `latest`.
`assertFlagCombinations`'s Backlog hint names the actor context (LORE_QUEST_ACTOR / LORE_QUEST_ACTOR_KIND / LORE_QUEST_ACCOUNTABLE_HUMAN).

`docs/reference/cli-surface.md` no longer describes the wizard's collision-retry exit-4 case, and its exit rows match the code as measured: exit 4 is `denied` including `--remove-backlog` refusals; scaffold collisions are exit 5 (`conflict`, `test/init.test.ts:1928`), as is Quest's id-collision refusal on the `--migrate-backlog` flag path (`src/tracker-migration.ts:244`). ADR-0024's own aside naming scaffold collisions as an exit-4 case was wrong and is corrected, marked, in the same PR; ADR-0017 carries its amendment pointer.
Gates green from source with the pinned bun (/opt/homebrew/bin/bun 1.4.2): `bun run lore check` exits 0 and `bun test` passes.

plan: 1. src/adapters/tracker-environment.ts: remove the installer; keep installCommandFor as text, pinned for quest.
2. src/cli.ts: forward a trackerEnvironment seam and no installer seam, so router tests never read the machine or shell npm.

3. src/commands/init.ts: chooseTracker gains the O1/O2 offer-and-continue arms and O12's one-shot bound; offerInstall/resolveMissingBinary/installSelectedBackendIfRequested lose their install arm; missingTrackerBinary takes the pinned remedy; the O3/O6 migration offer replaces the in-wizard migrate/keep/backlog prompt; runWizardBacklogMigration and its interactive collision retry are removed (runBacklogMigration stays for --migrate-backlog); assertFlagCombinations's Backlog hint gains the actor context.
4. test/cli.test.ts: the LORE-260 test injects a detected environment; it must never depend on, or mutate, the runner.
5. test/init.test.ts: the offer tests become stop-and-instruct tests; the --install-tracker tests become deprecation tests; the migration-prompt tests become offer tests.
6. docs/reference/cli-surface.md updated; ADR-0017 gets its amendment pointer at acceptance time.

7. Gates from source with the pinned bun: bun run lore check and bun test. Land on a follow-up PR (NOT on #433); realigning #433 follows this landing (step 3 of the successor order), then rc + opum-cli-e2e qualification (TASK-142, OPAG-761).
finalSummary:
Delivered in opum-ai/lore-cli#440, the pull request that closes this task into dev. Implements the accepted ADR-0024 (DEC-62 option A) inside the scope of its own "What implementation will touch" -- src/commands/init.ts, src/adapters/tracker-environment.ts, src/cli.ts, test/cli.test.ts, test/init.test.ts, docs/reference/cli-surface.md, ADR-0017's amendment pointer -- plus CHANGELOG.md, src/tracker-migration.ts (dormancy comments only) and docker/e2e/run-e2e.sh (the harness case the ADR's N1 stop invalidated).

All 11 acceptance criteria met. An independent adversarial reviewer (opum-workflow) judged each against the ADR's O1-O12 and N1-N10 tables with live CLI runs: the wizard stops leave the tree byte-identical (recursive listing plus per-file sha256), and the non-interactive readiness stops write nothing at all (N1 exit 3; N2/N6 exit 6). Three review defects were fixed before the PR: the readiness-before-N3 ordering, write-nothing assertions that could not see a regression, and two exports orphaned by the retry removal. A second review of the harness change caught two comments claiming coverage that could not fail and two checks weaker than their names; both fixed.

Gates, from source with the pinned bun 1.4.2: bun run lore check 83 files / 0 errors; bun test 4884 pass, 1 skip, 0 fail; tsc --noEmit clean; bun run lint exit 0 (pre-existing warnings only, in files byte-identical to dev); shell lint clean. CI run 36656747963 on 5ce3f89019b3f45907090da506220922fcb91888, and the docker e2e harness 392 passed / 0 failed locally on the shipped revision.

The windows-latest required context went green on this branch's first run -- the ADR's premise, that retiring lore's unpinned global install removes the repository's only global-install site, is what #433 needs after it realigns.

DEC-71 (which stop fires when the ADR's N1 and N3 rows both apply) was answered A, readiness first -- the reading already shipped, so nothing reverted. Deviations recorded rather than silently resolved: O7's stop keeps the pre-existing jira hint; the git preflight now follows the readiness gate on the explicit-flag path (the ADR orders neither); InitResult.installed retained, deprecated and always absent (ADR-0005); ADR-0024's exit-4 aside corrected in place and marked, with the measurement (scaffold collisions are exit 5, not 4).
